mintAuthority.summary: MSUSD has one canonical native issuance deployment on Ethereum. The Ethereum msUSDV2 token permits minting through configured minter 0x70c0c12 and stakedmsUSD/msY 0x890a5122, both controlled by the Ethereum DAO Safe, which can appoint callers and raise the mutable supply ceiling. Sonic is a LayerZero OFT representation and is assessed only in Bridge Risk.

sources.label: Ethereum MSUSD proxy and verified implementation

controls.label: MSUSD Ethereum minter contract
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25771195, minter() on the MSUSD proxy (0x4ba01f22827018b4772cd326c7627fb4956a7c00) returned 0x70c0c12fbb3acfff8e48abf027436971cf2ade14. The verified msUSDV2 source permits mint() from this configured minter, and its owner() is the Ethereum DAO Safe 0x0eAe4ACb10f3e5696cF6B0de33693eF8EC571858. The Safe-originated setMinter(address) simulation succeeded, preserving the ability to appoint a different canonical mint caller.

controls.label: MSUSD Ethereum owner (3/4 Safe)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25771195, Safe API and live reads confirmed that 0x0eAe4ACb10f3e5696cF6B0de33693eF8EC571858 is a 3-of-4 Safe with the four reviewed owners, no enabled modules, and a zero guard. The Safe owns the Ethereum msUSDV2 token, the configured minter 0x70c0c12fbb3acfff8e48abf027436971cf2ade14, and stakedmsUSD/msY 0x890a5122aa1da30fec4286de7904ff808f0bd74a; it can authorize caller changes and raise the token supplyLimit().

controls.label: MSUSD Ethereum stakedmsUSD (msY) mint caller
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25771195, stakedmsUSD() on the MSUSD proxy returned 0x890a5122aa1da30fec4286de7904ff808f0bd74a. The verified msUSDV2 source permits mint(address,uint256) when msg.sender is either minter or stakedmsUSD; a zero-amount mint simulation from this msY contract succeeded, while the DAO Safe itself was not an authorized direct caller. The msY owner() returned the same Ethereum DAO Safe.

sources.label: Ethereum MSUSD proxy and verified implementation

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25771195, the canonical msUSDV2 proxy owner is DAO Safe 0x0eAe4ACb10f3e5696cF6B0de33693eF8EC571858, minter() is 0x70c0c12fbb3acfff8e48abf027436971cf2ade14, and stakedmsUSD() is 0x890a5122aa1da30fec4286de7904ff808f0bd74a. The verified source permits both contracts to call mint(), and the Safe can appoint a new minter and raise supplyLimit(); the Ethereum UUPS upgrade path is owner-authorized with an UpgraderTimelockUpgradeable check, but the exact timelock address, delay, and queued-upgrade state were not independently read. Sonic block 77635499 shows the Sonic deployment is an OFT representation with minter() and stakedmsUSD() both zero, so its owner-controlled future-minter, cap, peer, and upgrade powers are excluded from this native assessment and recorded in Bridge Risk. Whole-supply reconciliation remains unknown after the Accountable verification failure and June 2026 freeze, and no prudential supervisor is evidenced.
